basic_details.job_title: ESIC Hospital Peenya Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 14 Senior Resident, Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Hospital Peenya, Bengaluru (Employees' State Insurance Corporation) will hold a walk-in interview on 12 November 2026, with registration from 09:15 A.M to 10:30 A.M at the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Peenya, Bengaluru (PIN not printed in the notice). It is engaging 10 Senior Residents under the Three Year Scheme and 4 Full Time/Part Time Specialists on contract; the notice says the numbers may be increased or decreased. Pay is Pay band in Level 11 plus allowances for Senior Residents, Rs 60,000 per month for Part Time Specialists and Rs 1,27,141 per month for Full

important_instructions: The engagement is purely on contract; selected candidates have no claim for regularization, and the appointment gives no right or preference for regular appointment. Either side may end the contract by giving one month's prior notice without assigning any reason. A Senior Resident who does not give one month's notice before resigning pays one month's salary or the shortfall. Senior Resident: a DD/Bankers Cheque of Rs 95,000 drawn in favour of 'ESIC A/c No 1' payable at Bengaluru is to be furnished as security deposit. If the candidate resigns or terminates within one year of the contract commencing, Rs 30,000 is appropriated towards administrative cost. Full Time/Part Time Specialist: a DD/Bankers Cheque of Rs 30,000 drawn in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at Bangalore is to be furnished as security deposit. Selected Specialists must hold a professional indemnity policy; the minimum sum assured per annum is Rs 30 lakhs for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc., Rs 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc., and Rs 10 lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc. A copy of the insurance and premium receipt must be submitted within 7 days of engagement. Part Time Specialists are not entitled to any kind of leave or benefits. Selected Senior Residents have no claim to PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical allowance, seniority, promotion or leave, and private practice is not allowed as they receive non-practicing allowance. Hostel accommodation, quarters and uniform are not provided. No TA/DA is admissible for the walk-in interview or for joining. Candidates must be registered with Karnataka Medical Council or MCI before joining. Selected candidates must open an SB Account in the State Bank of India if they do not hold one. Canvassing in any form is liable for disqualification. ESIC may cancel the recruitment at any stage, and the Administration may offer Full Time engagement; candidates applying for Full Time will be preferred. OBC candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must submit the community certificate in Annexure "A" as prescribed by DoPT OM No.36036/2/2013-Estt (Res) dated 30.05.2014; otherwise the benefit is not given and the candidate is treated as General Category.

content_sections.heading: About ESIC Hospital Peenya

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: The asterisk (*) in the notice means the vacancy includes posts unfilled in the previous walk-in interview. One Senior Resident post is horizontally reserved for the PwD category in an identified post. If no person with benchmark disability is available, the employer may fill the vacancy with another person, as per the DoPT Office Memorandum dated 15.01.2018. Only persons with not less than 40% disability are eligible for PwBD benefits, and a valid Disability Certificate from a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government is required; certificates from a medical practitioner, hospital or other institution are not accepted. For part time engagement, reservation policies are not applicable.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists duties only for Specialists: Part Time Specialist: available on call 24x7 if drawing emergency call charges. The Specialist is responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in his discipline.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Documents are required in original with one self-attested photocopy: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format (Annexure I). Age proof (Class 10th certificate/Birth certificate). MBBS certificate and PG Degree/Diploma/DNB certificate. Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC and I & A certificate for EWS candidates. OBC candidates must submit the latest OBC certificate as per Central Govt. proforma, not more than one year old from the date of interview. No age relaxation/reservation applies to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying for unreserved vacancies. MCI/SMC registration certificate with MD/MS/DNB qualification. Two recent passport size photographs. Experience certificate, if applicable. A candidate who is in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview. The Annexure I form asks for post applied, name, gender, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age on the date of interview, category, Aadhar number, addresses, mobile number, email, whether ESIC/Govt employee, medical council registration details, present post and institution, tentative date of joining, details of earlier Senior Resident service, educational qualification and experience, with a declaration and signature.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: All candidates report to the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Peenya, Bengaluru, within the registration time of 09:15 A.M to 10:30 A.M. The selection is by walk-in interview, and the decision of the Selection Board is final. Selection is subject to medical fitness; for Senior Residents it is also subject to verification of character and antecedents. An offer of appointment will be issued as per requirement. Selected candidates must join immediately or within 15 days from receipt of the offer or selection order.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Hospital Peenya walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12.11.2026, with registration from 09:15 A.M to 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: Candidates report to the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Peenya, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 14 posts: 10 Senior Resident under the Three Year Scheme and 4 Full Time/Part Time Specialist. The notice says the numbers may be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty, or MBBS with two years' working experience in the concerned department. Preference goes to PG Degree holders.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Specialist?
faq.answer: PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty with MCI registration, plus 3 years' experience after PG Degree or minimum 5 years after PG Diploma.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Senior Resident: not to exceed 45 years as on date of interview, with relaxation for reserved category as per rules. Specialist: not to exceed 69 years as on date of interview, and tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Senior Resident gets Pay band in the Level 11 plus allowances under ESIC rules. Part Time Specialist gets Rs 60,000 per month; Full Time Specialist gets a fixed Rs 1,27,141 per month including transport allowance.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the Annexure I form, age proof, MBBS and PG certificates, caste/EWS certificate if applicable, registration certificate, two passport size photographs and experience certificate, in original with one self-attested copy.

faq.question: Q9. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Senior Residents receive other allowances applicable under ESIC (Staff conditions of service Regulation, 1959) along with the Level 11 pay band. The Full Time Specialist amount includes transport allowance. The notice also says hostel, quarters, uniform and transport allowances will not be provided.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract, and selected candidates have no claim for regularization of service. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice.
